youtube_title: Train 3+ Hours Late? Get a FULL Refund #Shorts
youtube_description:
If your train runs more than 3 hours late and you don't travel, you get the full fare back. The catch: for an e-ticket you must file a TDR on IRCTC before the train actually departs (counter ticket: surrender it at the counter). No TDR = no refund. IRCTC > File TDR > 'Train late more than three hours'.
Source: Indian Railways refund rules / IRCTC TDR.
